% Pattern: theorem/newenvironment/article. A restatement environment sets
% the format of the theorem counter to its argument, a \ref to the theorem it
% restates, and puts the counter back at its end. The restated theorem has the
% number of the first one, and the next theorem goes on from the counter.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1 labels=main
% want thm-2 statement/theorem 2.1
% want restate-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want thm-3 statement/theorem 2.2
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
\newenvironment{restate}[1]
    {\def\thethm{#1}\begin{thm}}
    {\end{thm}\addtocounter{thm}{-1}}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm}\label{main} Each tree is a graph. \end{thm}
\section{Two}
\begin{thm} Each path is a tree. \end{thm}
\begin{restate}{\ref{main}}
Each tree is a graph.
\end{restate}
\begin{thm} Each star is a tree. \end{thm}
\end{document}
